proposed_reproduction_contract.rationale: Numerical first-reproduction diagnostics at unchanged devices and native replay; not ADC accuracy, lifetime or a zero-stress pass requirement.

boundary_differences: SAMPLE_INT/PHI_W/PHI_U/ACTIVE replace omitted sampler buffer/write/update/token networks with measured voltage histories.
TOPP/TOPN replace CDAC/Bootstrap input impedance and reciprocal comparator kickback; preserve recorded baseline voltages only.
DEC replaces omitted RAW/XOR/qualification feedback. Native COMP outputs and X002/X003 receivers remain physically driven.
PR/NR downstream qualification fanout and WD-to-X010 write-clock fanout are omitted; no artificial voltage clamps or guessed lumped capacitors replace them.
Full native SR internal feedback, clock buffer/direct load, Q1/LIVE/reset forward logic and original MOM/RC components are retained.
Stop before the original first compare at 43.468866 ns. This fixture addresses the 41.089515 ns event only.
Conditional PDK MOS replicas restore selected missing SN gate terminals with measured diffusion bias; original v1 feedback cuts remain.

coverage.note: A later marker proves prefix coverage without fabricating a stop row. A prefix marker is not a scanned full-source END.

SN_load_experiment.conditioning: Drain diffusion biases follow unchanged original source-native voltage histories; SN gate is naturally driven by the retained inverter.
limitations: Not full X010/X014 gate logic or reciprocal drain feedback.
No fitted capacitor, device resizing, forced SN, waveform smoothing or external sampling change.
Ideal diffusion-bias sources exchange energy; this fixture does not qualify whole-ADC power.
Record the original 1mV fidelity screen and all warnings; it does not mechanically block this sensitivity experiment.
SN_load_experiment.stop_policy: End at available real source-native history if earlier; no fabricated bias endpoint

standard_cell_experiment.current_binding: Actual MM numeric D/G/S/B ports1/2/3/4; same ND2D1 already verified in X001/X020. New paths must bind natively; no zeros or guessed primitive paths.

terminal_voltage_policy.method: Six simultaneous native terminal pairs per101 MOS zero-to-END plus3 legacy aliases; all core limits0.99V unchanged.
terminal_voltage_policy.junctions: Signed VDB/VSB retained. Absolute screen is not forward-junction or lifetime qualification.

source_operating_point_resistance.policy: Observed finite-bias V/I of existing loaded R0, not a universal linear resistance or a measurement of new RINPUT. No new simulation or model fitting.

standard_cell_r0_experiment.rationale: Mechanism test of incident negative coupling/input edge, not a presumed repair or acceptance by moving stress.
standard_cell_r0_experiment.energy_policy: Streaming reducer observes -V*I for both R ports; dedicated wrapper removes them from five-source energy and reports absorbed passive work=-sum(port work).
